meta.title: Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Finance Advisory Services
meta.description: Explore every Yaqeen Advisory service: bookkeeping, GST, VAT, corporate tax, Zakat, payroll, MIS, IFRS reporting, FP&A, audit support and finance automation.

hero.heading: Everything your finance function needs, in one team
hero.text: Accounting, tax, payroll, reporting, FP&A, audit support and automation for businesses in India and the GCC. Pick a service to see exactly what we do.

layers.heading: Three layers. Pay only for what you use.
layers.text: Every client gets a core subscription. Add modules when you need them, and bring in projects for one-time work.

items.title: Core subscription
items.text: Monthly and ongoing. Choose Foundation, Growth or CFO. The tier sets the depth of insight, from compliance to analysis to strategy.

items.title: Add-on modules
items.text: Monthly or per cycle. Extra employees, extra entities, Ind AS or IFRS reporting and more, priced by the driver.

items.title: Projects
items.text: One-time, fixed fee. Books clean-ups, audit readiness, financial models and system setup, scoped up front and delivered with a clear handover.
